title: MEIKO — Who We Are〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ichika and Saki came up with such an incredible debut single.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It embodies both of them... It's the perfect song for introducing Leo/need to the world.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree. I'm really looking forward to hearing them play it as a band.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO.
I thought you were practicing with Rin.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm taking a short break.
KAITO is keeping her company for now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku and I were just talking about the girls' debut single.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that song?
Talk about an incredible piece of music.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not only that, compared to their other ones, this felt really new and fresh for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, I think I know what you mean.
It must be because they wrote it together.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. Ichika said that she'd try to do what we did in terms of turning Saki's thoughts and feelings into music...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And she couldn't have achieved a better result.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Also, something tells me that Ichika was the only person who could turn Saki's feelings into such an incredible song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, she seemed so determined to make sure it turned out well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I agree...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I still can't believe how Ichika and Saki were able to come up with such an incredible song in such a short amount of time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But at the same time...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't think they're fully satisfied.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Not fully satisfied...?
Because they had to make a fairly drastic change?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes... Of course, them choosing to make that change wasn't bad or anything.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But it's just...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They didn't get to do what they actually wanted, which I'm sure frustrates them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm guessing they were both hoping to work in all of their feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, since they're both really kind and such close friends. And I doubt either wanted to give on their ideas.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I mean, they ended up fighting. I think that's a testament to how determined they both were...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, that's true...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you sound strangely happy about that, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to the future is all.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Those two went through a bit of a rough patch...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But they still ended up accomplishing their goal.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They were tasked with writing Leo/need's debut single together from start to finish, which was a completely new challenge for them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But that's not all.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They ended up fighting over what it should be about...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They were both determined to write it a certain way. Neither was willing to yield to the other, and they've both learned that about themselves.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which I think is a big step forward.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A big step...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, and this experience should prove invaluable to them both.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, I believe the inability to do everything they wanted will cause them to grow even more in the future.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As they experience new things and take on new challenges, they'll learn to write even better songs.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And someday, they'll be able to write a song that encompasses both of their feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm certain of that after seeing what happened this time around.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're going to grow even more...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm definitely looking forward to that happening...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They've written their debut single, but their journey as pros is just beginning...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I really can't wait to see how their story unfolds.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Me neither.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll need to keep a close eye on them.
